entries.source: Archiv der Evangelischen Kirche im Rheinland, 8SL 033, Nr. 176
entries.english:
Collection of material on the church situation

New Racial Policy Office theses on National Socialist colonial racial policy; Johannes Hötzel's address to Womrath congregation before announcing church discipline; report on formal disciplinary proceedings against Pastor Müller, Berlin-Dahlem; copy of “The Church's Word on the Jewish Question”; first Confessing Church Synod of the German Evangelical Church at Wuppertal-Barmen, 29–31 May 1934; Women's Aid in the Rhineland; 19th Westphalian Confessing Synod circular, 25 January 1935; Solingen-Wald Evangelical congregation presbytery resolution against Rosenberg, 5 April 1935; training service; Pastor Asmussen's biblical address at Johanniskirche in Giessen, 16 May 1935; “A Word on Training Theological Candidates”; Oberfischenbach Evangelical congregation; preparatory committee of the Reich Brethren Council; Regional Church and Provincial Church Committees for the Evangelical Church of the Old Prussian Union statement on moving confirmation celebrations, 29 March 1936; completed visitation questionnaire for the Old Prussian Union church in the Rhineland (cf. no. 38); invitations and circulars to synod members; Rhineland visitation; press review on suppression of Protestant youth work in Ruppin district and Seelow and church-committee personnel policy; Hesse's letter for the Reformed Federation for Germany to Robert Steiner, 24 May 1936, on the church convention in Hannover on 2 June 1936; report on the East Prussian Provincial Church Committee; press releases; Karl Barth lecture in Achaffhausen, 15 March 1936, “The Confessing Church in Germany Today”; Reich Church Committee opinion on Reich Bishop Ludwig Müller's “German Words of God”; Bavarian Pastors' Brotherhood circular 28, 25 June 1936; “The Castle,” Society for Biblical and Evangelical Church Work bulletin, vol. 9, September 1937, issues 1/2; report on attack on Odenspiel Protestant rectory on the night of 7 November 1937; data on Pastor Schneider/Dickenscheid; Sup. Lic. Albertz-Spandau at Old Church, Pankow confession rally, 29 November 1938; copy of Pastor Hermann Diem's letter to Bishop Wurm, 18 March 1939; copy of Reformed Confessing Church Convention executive committee opinion on the Old Prussian Union Mark Brandenburg Evangelical Consistory disciplinary chamber's judgment against Sup. Lic. Albertz, pronounced 29 April 1940; General Superintendent D. Blau, Senior Consistorial Councillor D. Kleindienst, Bishop D. Plöchau, Sup. Zöckler, and Provost Thomson to Reich Governor in Posen, 18 January 1941; carbon copy of Sup. Lic. Albertz's letter to the Reformed Convention executive committee, 1943; Reformed Federation circulars; church chronicle in verse by O. Hänzsch, undated carbon copy.
